_comment: Remote Input module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_fire_and_forget_note: input_mouse_move uses Fire-and-Forget strategy. Agent does NOT send an ACK response for mouse_move unless an error occurs (e.g. missing parameters), preventing network flood at 60+ events/sec. Controller must not wait for ACK on move events.

input_mouse_move._desc: Move mouse cursor to absolute screen coordinates (pixels on primary screen). NOTE: Fire-and-Forget (Agent does NOT send ACK for move).

input_key._desc: Simulate keyboard key event by Virtual Key code (vk: integer VK code, action: 'down'|'up'|'press')

input_type._desc: Type text string via SendInput UNICODE

input_result._desc: Agent returns execution result for mouse click, key, or type commands

input_result_error._desc: Agent returns failure status if parameters are invalid or execution fails
